terminalStateMap.approved: Structured assessment recorded; native execution still checks binding, cancellation and current user authorization
terminalStateMap.denied: AUTO_REVIEW_DENIED includes rationale, no-circumvention/safer-alternative guidance and recent denial ID
terminalStateMap.timed-out: AUTO_REVIEW_TIMEOUT explicitly says timeout is not proof of unsafe action
terminalStateMap.failed: AUTO_REVIEW_FAILED asks to resolve the review failure without bypassing review

thresholds.nonDenial: Resets consecutive count and enters rolling window as false

turnHooks.begin: Pi agent_start begins one user agent loop; ordinary model tool iterations do not reset counters
turnHooks.interrupt: ReviewLifecycle abort signal cancels pending guarded operations and context.abort interrupts actual Pi turn
turnHooks.session: session_start/session_tree/reset clear retry authority and restore selected branch provenance
turnHooks.staleAuthorization: Trusted user/instruction scope changes during review invalidate admission before native execution

retryBinding.selection: TUI/RPC picker or exact supplied ID; critical denials rejected
retryBinding.identity: tool/input/source/cwd/session/context/policy/profile; excludes fresh toolCallId and the per-invocation origin digest of an otherwise identical network request
retryBinding.marker: Controller-local, atomically consumed once; included only in the exact retry review as user-confirmation; no persistent grant
retryBinding.execution: Model/nested retry through normal guarded tools using original caller arguments; direct user shell uses exact guarded command and fresh review
retryBinding.freshReview: Never reuses cached grants for a selected retry; critical and absolute policy denials remain non-overridable
retryBinding.lifetime: Cleared on session/branch replacement and pending markers invalidated by a new genuine user input

statusSurfaces.ui: Bounded Korean reviewing/approved/denied/aborted/timed-out/failed status; concurrent count and denial warning
statusSurfaces.audit: Existing identity fields plus bounded redacted status/riskLevel/userAuthorization/rationale; no request or tool argument storage
statusSurfaces.mainAgent: Typed guard errors and exact-denial instructions
